what_to_detect: A spell cast for its awaken cost resolves and puts +1/+1 counters on a target land its controller controls.
near_miss: The same kind of spell cast for its mana cost resolves and puts no counter on a land.
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
outcome_event's api is Keyword for an awaken cast, so api PutCounter never matches it

what_to_detect: A card with awaken cast for its mana cost needs no land target: its candidate has a legal target although its controller controls no land.
near_miss: The awaken-cost candidate of the same card has no legal target, because its controller controls no land.
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
verdict_bit with fires_when true and no keyword restriction matches nearly every decision record
